messages.subject: problem with colsplit functio
parts:
Hi there,

I am trying to split a column whose variable names contain information about more than one variable. This is how the dataframe looks like after melting:

     File variable   value
1   s2    Fz_15  0,1394
2   s3    Fz_15  6,3006
3   s5    Fz_15 -0,0541
4   s6    Fz_15 -2,1836
5   s8    Fz_15 -1,9381
6   s9    Fz_15 -3,5876

What I need to do is to split the "variable" column by the "_", so that I can have a column that contains "Fz" and one that contains "15" (which will be respectively called "electrode" and "trigger". This is what I was trying to to:

     data3<-cbind(data2, colsplit(data2$variable, split="_", names=c("electrode", "trigger")))

but the only thing I get is this error output:

  Errore in colsplit(data2$variable, split = "_", names = c("electrode",  : 
  unused argument(s) (split = "_")

I have tried using different separators or (no separators, i.e. putting e.g.Fz15), but nothing works. Any suggestion?

Thanks a lot.

Simona

messages.subject: Re: problem with colsplit functio
parts:
Hi,

I'm guessing you are using reshape2, in which the split argument to
colsplit has been changed to pattern. Try

data3<-cbind(data2, colsplit(data2$variable, pattern="_",

colsplit has been changed to pattern. Try
